summary: Open habituation data for Physarum exist (Dryad 51j89 and p3720, both CC0, the latter with plain-text tables whose headers were read). Open data for the decision half (growth toward the heavier of two inert objects, Murugan et al. 2021) and for morphology-as-behavior time series were not found; the Frontiers 2023 videos are the only morphology link located.
